planets.name: GJ 9827 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 9827 with a 3.65-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: GJ 9827 c was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around GJ 9827. Its orbit and size follow Passegger et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
